3703-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
3703-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 green Saproling creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

293-4247-5220-5716.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Selhoff Occultist and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Narcomoeba from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Selhoff Occultist trigger, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1
Repeat.

3317-4247-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3317-4247-5972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Historian's Boon triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

997-2728-6854-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
997-2728-6854-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
997-2728-6854-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3587-6831.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Boros Reckoner indestructible after it enters.
You have a way to deal damage to Boros Reckoner after it enters.
3587-6831.description:
Cast Boros Reckoner by paying its mana cost.
Give Boros Reckoner indestructible.
Deal damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing double that much damage to itself due to Neriv.
Repeat step 4 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the final Boros Reckoner trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to any target.
3587-6831.notes: If the source that is dealing damage to Boros Reckoner is repeatable (such as Pyrohemia), you can deal damage to Boros Reckoner again and redirect the damage elsewhere.

1170-5078-6979-7913.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-5078-6979-7913.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7768.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Chaotic Goo.
When Chaotic Goo dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1368-5477-6321-7175.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5477-6321-7175.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1061-5625-7679.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
An opponent cannot block and kill Phelia.
1061-5625-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Phelia.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

67-997-4053-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W}
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

539-2292-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a land you control

515-1636-1648.description:
Animate the land that has Squirrel Nest attached using Nissa of Shadowed Boughs.
Activate the land with Squirrel Nest attached by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

1402-1753-2644-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2173-2292-5220-6535.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1987-4311-4423-6700.easyPrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-4311-4423-6700.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome.
When Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome enters untapped, they trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarevok's Tome trigger, causing you to take the initiative.
Repeat.

301-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites: You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-5643-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

2178-2511-6773.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard
2178-2511-6773.description:
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature returned in step 1.
When the creature dies, Xu-Ifit triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

5189-5231-5439-6753.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
5189-5231-5439-6753.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

500-654-3125-4050-4867.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature.
500-654-3125-4050-4867.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding one mana.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Cormela and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put one of the Cormela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Cormela that died in step 3 and the Cormela that died in step 4 each trigger, returning Victimize and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Cormela token by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Cormela token, adding one mana.
When the Cormela token dies, it triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B}, causing you to sacrifice the Cormela token and return Cormela and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the tapped permanents enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers for each one, untapping them.
Put the token Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Cormela triggers, returning up to one instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6169.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6169.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Ob Nixilis trigger.
Resolve the Ob Nixilis trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1365-1477-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
Extruder does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1477-4853.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Extruder and the other artifact creature with base toughness 2 or greater persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing it, targeting the other artifact creature.
When Extruder dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Extruder trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability from step 2, putting a +1/+1 on the targeted creature.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the other artifact creature, targeting Extruder.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion triggers.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping any artifact you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

12-1339-4509.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
There is at least one Insect on the battlefield.
12-1339-4509.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters the battlefield, Garruk's Uprising's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
12-1339-4509.notes: This combo will result in you drawing your library, and losing the game if it isn't interacted with. Ensure you have a way to avoid this before starting the combo.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-2829-5263.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Arcbound Ravager abilities from steps 1 and 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-2719-2736-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2719-2736-5096.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {R}{W}{U}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

1806-2382-5231-5465.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {R}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

57-2178-3621-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-3621-5231.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {R}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it and Feldon of the Third Path trigger.
Resolve the Feldon of the Third Path trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

654-1671-3177-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Sakura-Tribe Scout does not have summoning sickness.
654-1671-3177-4222.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

3172-3499-4499.notablePrerequisites: Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
3172-3499-4499.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Patron of the Orochi by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat.
If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3679-4050-4605-4681.description:
Cast Breath of Life by paying {3}{W}, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide and Preston trigger.
In response, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {W}.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Preston's trigger, creating a 0/1 Illusion token copy of Karmic Guide.
The token Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Illusion tokens and infinite mana, you may activate Preston any number of times.

2773-4245.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Vrondiss indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Vrondiss.
2773-4245.description:
Give Vrondiss indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss triggers, creating a 5/4 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, dealing five damage to Vrondiss.
Vrondiss and the Dragon token trigger.
Resolve the Dragon's trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Resolve the Vrondiss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

1283-2198-2556-3647.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Displace by paying {3}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Deceiver Exarch.
Mnemonic Wall and Deceiver Exarch enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-3094-3469-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Zethi and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{U}.
249-3094-3469-4091.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{U}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Zethi's triggered ability.
Resolve the copy of Zethi's ability, creating a copy of each card exiled with a kick counter of it and causing you to pay {W}{U} to cast the copy of Energy Arc.
Resolve the Energy Arc copy, untapping all mana producing creatures you control and Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use that mana to then cast the copies of all other cards exiled with kick counters on them.
